provenance.citation: Reyes-Ortiz, J., Anguita, D., Ghio, A., Oneto, L., & Parra, X. (2013). Human Activity Recognition Using Smartphones [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C54S4K
provenance.license_discrepancy: Current UCI landing page lists CC BY 4.0; bundled 2013 README states commercial use is prohibited. Both source statements are preserved; no legal conclusion about the discrepancy is made.
provenance.independence: Subjects are disjoint across train/validation/test; overlapping windows within subjects are not independent
provenance.released_preprocessing: Use UCI's released 561 time/frequency features; their historical normalization is inherited

authorization.scope: Local CPU-only benchmark; no remote VM or QPU

limits: Independent two-qubit patches; nominal8/16 qubits are not a fully entangled statevector or a hardware advantage.
The same-model vector verifies optimizer parameters/gradients and selected final predictions, not every intermediate feature Jacobian.
Seed subsets share subjects across replicates; no confidence interval or independent-subject significance claim.
Common archive download/text preparation is separate from each timed NPZ read and train-only preprocessing.
Partial blocks and incomplete repeat sets never support wins.
